venue_and_social.desc: Wide landscape interior establishing photograph of an inviting contemporary neighbourhood Italian burger pub. Rustic oak tables, olive-green upholstered banquette, black metal stools, exposed warm brick, softly illuminated beer taps behind a timber bar, amber pendant lamps. Simple welcoming affordable casual bar, no marble, no gold, no luxury. Late afternoon natural light at right, left side darker with space for headline. No people. Wide 3:2 image.

Wide landscape candid photograph in the same type of warm casual neighbourhood burger pub: a diverse group of four adult friends in their 30s chatting naturally around a wooden table with burgers, fries and draft beers. Warm brick, olive-green banquette, black iron details, relaxed authentic good company, not luxury dining, no staged toast toward camera. Wide 3:2 image.

Wide landscape close editorial photo of a bartender hands pulling a perfectly foaming golden draft beer at an understated casual neighbourhood pub. Timber bar, black metal beer taps, warm brick and softly blurred pendant bulbs. Honest tactile casual bar atmosphere, rich amber beer and creamy foam, shallow depth of field. No logos, no faces. Wide 3:2.

Wide landscape photograph of a cosy informal pub veranda, wooden tables and black metal chairs with warm festoon bulbs, terracotta pots and green plants, dusk blue outside, casual neighbourhood hamburger bar, no luxury. One foreground table for four with clean simple paper menus without readable text. Enough depth to see a passage to a warm brick indoor bar. Wide 3:2.

Square candid Instagram-quality food photo, appetizing double smash cheeseburger with crinkly melted cheddar, toasted bun and pickle, crispy golden fries on a simple metal tray lined with off-white paper, cold unbranded draft beer on rustic wood tabletop. Friendly casual pub with warm lighting. Close overhead three-quarter camera, tactile, natural, no luxury styling, no text.

Square spontaneous editorial photograph of two adult friends hands gently clinking pints of golden beer above a timber bar, warm casual pub in soft background, black metal beer taps and brick wall. Natural human hands, creamy foam, condensation, warm inviting photographic light, no faces, no brands, no text.

Square social media food photograph looking down at a shared pub table: onion rings, mozzarella bites, fries, small spicy sauce bowl, two casual cocktails and fragments of friends sleeves at the corners. Rustic oak table, relaxed weekday evening, warm practical light, affordable welcoming burger bar rather than fine dining. No text, no logos.
